notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.5
notes.content:
Hello Tea Witches! We’ve pushed a new version (1.1.5) that has the following updates:

[list]
[*] Added two new CGs - one of Zero in episode “Into the Stargazing” and one of Kingsley in “No Sugar Daddies Allowed”
[*] Minor edits here & there
[*] Limited FPS to a more normal range
[*] Added support for the Demo version
[*] Various minor bug fixes
[/list]

We still have a few more updates planned for the game such as more CGs that will be published in several updates in the next few months. In the meantime, please continue to report any bugs you come across through our Discord server for quick, direct access to our team - or through the in-game feedback form in the menu screen.
